original_card.acceptance_gate: A new physically realizable contract outside the frozen catalogue whose per-call profile, screened with ceiling.ceiling(), beats the selected word's packing ceiling; a lower cap does not establish identical circuitry or order attainable optima, and is insufficient to pass the stronger-budget target under this model. actual_scope: Extend the two-output temporary-sum anchor from two clean outputs to arbitrary dirty additive targets, verify its exact reversible map, test the selected #1094 target-dirt boundary, and screen its hypothetical seven-block recursive profile with scalar additions invoiced separately.
scope_change_reason: The predecessor construction requires clean output anchors, but the selected provider preserves arbitrary entry dirt in all 112 target coordinates. Temporarily summing the two dirty anchors lets each other target cancel both dirt terms with one shear; restoring the anchor before the products retains q recursive children and uses 2q scalar ADDs, which are charged in the separate scalar envelope.
bottleneck_link: The selected local word has 2,412 rank-one children per call and under 0.87% fixed-word packing headroom. Seven q=112 blocks would reduce the hypothetical rank-one count to 872 and raise the local complex ceiling above the unchanged bit endpoint if a source-compatible supplier exists.
stop_rule: Attempt one exact selected-source 112-output factorization and full child/frame/scalar/caller/cleanup invoice. Stop if its product slices do not match P,Q,P+Q+Ri or if the complete interface bill consumes the recursive-child saving. Search for seven disjoint blocks only after one instance closes.
evidence: This contribution does not improve selected kappa, which remains 0.001672660197076918; this is a scoped claim about the submitted result, not a universal no-improvement theorem. The symbolic forward map and inverse pass for all 110 widths 3..112; exact slice rank is q; finite checks cover 588,500 F2/F3 assignments and reject five mutations. The pinned selected forward endpoint preserves the independent entry-dirt coordinate in all 112 targets. Seven hypothetical blocks give rank1=872, complex kappa ceiling 0.002368554974, and an adapter-plus-unit-addition upper screen below 2^48. The temporary dirty-sum schedule uses 224 affine additions per q=112 block. No selected product decomposition or whole-supplier replay is established.
